summary: The host suite did not complete (the sandbox stopped answering during the run). I then played the kite as the player: the meter, running, A/D turns and Space/E all work, and the view had no friend in the way over 6 s of running. Problems found: after Stop the kite is gone, so Play again gives no kite; Sprout is tiny and overlapped by the key-hint bar; the first view after jump-in was blocked by a house. Flower gifts and outfits pass when run directly. The sandbox frame median was 208 ms.

failures.what: Stop and then Play again gives no kite. Sprout goes sunbathing and the kite never comes back in the same afternoon.
failures.steps: Fly the kite, press Play (Sprout holds the kite), press Stop, then press Play again within a few seconds. Wait 16 s: the kite flyer stays 0, K[:up] stays true, and the meter is not shown.
failures.expected: A player who steps out and back in (or the second Play) gets the kite again, or at least a visible kite.
failures.actual: The kite flyer is 0 and the kite is gone. Test 'Kite player (s58): Play, Stop, Play again works and the meter comes back' fails.

failures.what: While running with the kite, Sprout is tiny at the bottom of the frame and partly covered by the key-hint bar 'WASD walk, E wave, Space jump'. The kite and sky fill the view.
failures.steps: Play with the kite up (afternoon, kite meadow), hold W for a few seconds, then take a screenshot.
failures.expected: Sprout, the player's own creature, is clearly visible and not behind the HUD.
failures.actual: Sprout is a few pixels tall, with a wooden sawhorse in front and the hint bar over its legs.

failures.what: Right after jumping in with the kite flying, Sprout was hidden behind a large orange house wall (first frames), and a few seconds later a pink critter with a hat filled the foreground in front of Sprout. The game said 'Oof! Something's in the way. Turn with A or D!' (observed in the first exploration run; the final tests found no blocker at the time they measured).
failures.steps: Same start as above, screenshot right after Play and after about 5 s of W+A.
failures.expected: Sprout and the kite both clear in the chase view.
failures.actual: Sprout hidden behind an orange wall at the start, behind a critter after steering.

failures.what: The sandbox is slow: frame median 208 ms (p95 336 ms) against a 30 fps target, and system:camcut takes about 102 ms per frame. Seen at 27-30 fps in the screenshots afterwards, so it may only be the time just after a restart. The sandbox also restarted by itself during my session.
failures.steps: live_status() right after the sandbox came back.
failures.expected: About 33 ms per frame, camcut under 1 ms.
failures.actual: See above. The host's own suite also stopped partway (last_run.json holds only the 3 kite tests).

tests_added: Kite player (s58): A and D turn Sprout while running, Space and E keep the kite in Sprout's hand
Kite player (s58): Play, Stop, Play again works and the meter comes back
Kite player (s58): while running, no friend or solid fills the view between the camera and Sprout
Kite player (s58): Sprout is in view right after jumping in, not hidden behind a house or a friend
